hypothesis: The frozen-V2 residual codebook preserves complementary view evidence, and the generic query-conditioned residual attention can convert it to stronger canonical-negative primitive unaries without benchmark-specific fitting.

frozen_candidate.router_seed_policy: seed0 fixed before benchmark opening; no benchmark-based seed selection or ensemble
frozen_candidate.radio_feature_gauge: l2_direction, fixed to the codebook training contract before benchmark opening
frozen_candidate.formula: slotwise sigmoid(10*(positive_cosine-max_generic_negative_cosine)), followed by the frozen shared query router

controls.new_contract_exact_fallback: materialized in the same run from slot zero, before router attention
controls.attribution_rule: Report old-to-new-base and new-base-to-router deltas separately. Do not attribute a contract/readout change to the router.

sentinel_gate.primary: router mIoU must exceed the accepted old-contract result by at least 0.005
sentinel_gate.mechanistic: router mIoU must exceed the same-run new-contract exact fallback mIoU
sentinel_gate.failure_action: reject benchmark expansion and diagnose train/deploy or background false-positive mismatch; do not tune scene thresholds, graph parameters, or seed
sentinel_gate.pass_action: expand unchanged to all four LERF3D scenes and apply the existing full4 gate
